description: Hand-built map from Coursera courses in a mined edge (Ring 1 of pipeline/evidence/edges_coursera_course.json) to the Pathwise catalog items they belong to (src/data/catalog.json; specializations and certificates are many-to-one). Used by tag_courses.py to fill catalogItemId, and by pool.py so an edge inside a specialization the catalog already carries shows as evidence on that item. Courses not listed here belong to no catalog item.

relations.member: the course is one of the item's courses
relations.predecessor: the course was retired and replaced by the item
relations.shared-course: the course belongs to the item and to another programme that is not in the catalog
